Keep from-scratch useful previews separate where UI cannot author required runtime policy; record absent authoring capability as product finding requiring scope decision.
Multiple installed systems keep data/session isolation; stop closes/revokes exact runtime window/session and retained transcript survives restart.
Denied capability, revoked release, unavailable model, launch compensation and repeated click cannot bypass approval or create an orphaned runtime.
external_dependencies: actual installed qualified model for inference; native process/window observations; no imported/authored sandbox execution authority

required_behavior: Every reachable major form/dialog/tab/tree/menu/notification has role/name/state, keyboard completion, focus trap/return where applicable and meaningful errors/status.
Assert real viewport320px control access, native zoom where supported, computed reduced-motion/forced-colors, theme/contrast and no overlapped action labels.
Accessibility scan incomplete/indeterminate results require resolution or explicit pending technical finding; no manual screen-reader or participant task is a roadmap criterion.
Measure initial shell/first page, cold/warm Canvas, large/sparse picker, representative artifact/model lists and UI edit-to-paint with declared workloads.
Reuse recorded budgets/reference profiles; new targets are predeclared after diagnostic baselines, account for laptop memory and distinguish readiness timeout from latency goal.
Retain failures, p50/p95/repeat counts/source identity; synthetic clocks cannot claim real latency. Run serially with no competing model/build workload.
external_dependencies: named actual reference host for performance claims

required_behavior: Every scenario reports exact source, scenario/host/profile, executed/skipped/failed status, expected outcome, assertion stage, safe error code and owned cleanup.
Setup/teardown/crash/empty discovery/unexecuted critical cases fail or remain pending; retry never erases first failure or converts an unavailable environment to pass.
Interrupted standalone collection can restart without stale locks killing future runs; preserve old artifacts and only rerun missing evidence by source/criterion identity.
Use allowlisted numeric/finite diagnostics, bounded retention and synthetic fixtures; disable traces/capture where they would retain tokens/prompts/content.
Logo/Home, header menu, sidebar collapse and Build/Manage/Admin group toggles remain keyboard accessible and retain only declared presentation preferences.
Outside click and Escape dismiss where the current interaction contract requires it; current-page indicators and accessible names survive collapsed navigation.
Glossary hints and shared help explain controls without obscuring required actions or exposing internal implementation details.
Keep existing read-only review site regression coverage for Open/Completed sections, original creation-date sorting, canonical completion status and dynamic refresh.
Expand roadmap increments to work chunks and acceptance evidence, navigate linked supporting work and show pending/failed/blocked distinctly.
Default dark mode, light/dark toggle, persisted validated preference and storage failure remain usable; the site never grants approval or mutation authority.
